beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: A few days after the review, Riley's back, calmer than she was on the phone.

beats.prompt: The past: the space you claimed when the label pushed back.
The present: the trust you're still building in the booth.
The future: how you actually respond when it stings.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Quiz me on the new one. If Strength is about staying gentle, doesn't that mean I'm supposed to just feel fine about the review? Because I don't."

options.text: No — it's not about not feeling it, it's about not letting it curdle into force.
Yes, feeling anything at all fails the card.
Feelings aren't relevant to Strength at all.

elaboration: Real strength is gentle — it comes from the heart, not force. It never asked you to feel nothing, just to answer with the gentler instinct instead of the aggressive one.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "What if staying generous about it just makes me look like I don't care?"

options.text: Generosity and warmth are forms of power too — it's not the same as not caring.
You're right, you should look like you don't care.
Generosity has nothing to do with Strength.

elaboration: Generosity and warmth are forms of power too — connection, not standing above someone, is where this card's strength actually lives.

beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: "One thread ties all three: the space you claimed, the trust you're building, and now, the gentler kind of strong."

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Yeah. I think I've been treating gentle like it was the opposite of strong, when it's actually just a different kind of it. Thank you."
